raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`MiniMaxH3Pipeline._load_config` fetched the checkpoint first (`maybe_download_model`) and only then parsed `_minimax_h3.sigma_shift_scales` with a bare `float()`. On the real MiniMax-H3 index this accepted `-12.0`, `NaN` and the string `"12"` (silently turned into 12.0). The request-time timestep stage rejects non-positive values, but only after the whole model has loaded, and then for every request.

## Modifications

- Add `validate_minimax_h3_sigma_shift_scales` (`configs/minimax_h3_metadata.py`), which requires a positive finite number (not a bool) for both modalities. It is shared by the full release metadata parser (`.../minimax_h3/release_metadata.py`) and a new `_preflight_model_config` hook.
- `composed_pipeline_base.py` / `minimax_h3_pipeline.py`: the hook runs before the weights are fetched. It is a no-op for other pipelines. For H3 it reads `model_index.json` from the selected partition, or the overlay metadata for the FastH3 and VDN-H3 source repositories, without downloading any weights.
- `test/unit/test_minimax_h3_metadata.py`: invalid values are rejected before any weight download for the plain, FastH3 and VDN-H3 pipelines, local and remote; the parser rejects bad values before float coercion; the selected index matches the weight directory and revision; a missing or damaged index does not fall back to a weight download; other pipelines do not fetch metadata.

## Accuracy Tests

Unit: `test_minimax_h3_metadata.py` 7 passed, 68 subtests passed. Without the fix the new tests fail.

Real MiniMax-H3 FL2VA checkpoint, TP2 on 2 x B200, t2va, 4 s, 50 steps, seed 42. Server runs on this branch head, on a merge of the three H3 fixes (this PR, the VAE tile validation and the sigma preflight), and on unpatched `main` (`2948662026`).

**Regression** (bit-identical, so no frame comparison is shown; unpatched `main` vs this branch merged with the other two H3 fixes). Frame difference is 0 at every sampled pixel, and the video/audio latents and mp4 match bit for bit:

| | unpatched `main` | merged fixes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| video latent `[1,24,32,48,84]` + audio latent `[2,32,178]`, sha256 prefix | `e3f82e7f2006` | `e3f82e7f2006` |
| decoded mp4 (107 frames, 768x1344), sha256 prefix | `d7ffac37f960` | `d7ffac37f960` |
| max abs pixel difference, frames 0 / 53 / 106 | - | 0 / 0 / 0 |


**Bad `sigma_shift_scales.video`** (copy of the real checkpoint with only `model_index.json` changed, everything else symlinked to the real weights):

| value | unpatched `main` | this branch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| real (number) | generates | generates, bit-identical |
| `-12.0` | server loads all weights (312 s to healthy), every request then fails: `model sigma_shift_scales.video must be a positive finite number` | startup `ValueError: model_index.json._minimax_h3.sigma_shift_scales.video must be a positive finite number`, before weights are fetched |
| `NaN` | same as `-12.0` | same startup error |
| `"12"` (string) | server starts and generates, value silently read as 12.0 | same startup error |

When the problem is reported (measured, same job group; on the exact final head with all three fixes merged, `-12.0` fails at startup after 119 s):

| value | unpatched `main` | this branch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-12.0` | healthy at 255.1 s, request fails after 5.2 s (260.3 s) | startup error at 124 s |
| `NaN` | healthy at 249.1 s, request fails after 5.2 s (254.3 s) | startup error at 135 s |
| `"12"` | healthy at 252.1 s, request completes in 35.2 s with the value read as 12.0 | startup error at 130 s |

![time to report](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fusheng-ji/sglang/423113d8a26b0cda0e5b8586899655c2be2514db/minimax-h3-sigma-time.png)

Times are seconds from server start. For `main`, healthy time and request time come from the harness; for this branch, the time is the timestamp of the startup error in the server log relative to the first log line (a few seconds after process start). The branch's process then takes about 1.5-2 more minutes to exit (existing shutdown behaviour), which is not counted. Weights were warm in the page cache, so the saving here is the rest of the load plus the failing request; for a remote repository it would also include the download. Run-to-run load time varies (main healthy in 249-312 s across these runs).

Calling `_load_config()` directly on the real `model_index.json`: `main` accepts all three values, and for `-12.0` only reaches a verdict after the weight-fetch call; this branch rejects each in about 0.002 s without calling it.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not a performance change. The fix only touches the failure path / load-time validation; the regression run below produced bit-identical output, but latency was not measured.

The benefit on a local checkpoint is small (weights were already in the page cache, so loading took 25-40 s); for a remote repository the saving is the weight download, which was not measured.

Limitations: the preflight rejects quoted numbers such as `"12"`, which the old code accepted. The real checkpoint uses numbers and is unaffected, but a third-party `model_index.json` that stores the scales as strings will go from loading to failing. The FastH3 / VDN-H3 overlay and remote-download paths are covered by mocked unit tests only. Only the FL2VA partition, t2va, TP2 and one prompt/seed were run on real weights.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (Not applicable: no option or documented behaviour changes.)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (Accuracy only; this is a correctness fix and no speed measurement was made.)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Lightweight validation shared by H3 metadata preflight and full parsing."""
+
+import math
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from typing import Any
+
+
+def validate_minimax_h3_sigma_shift_scales(
+    model_index: Mapping[str, Any],
+) -> dict[str, float]:
+    path = "model_index.json._minimax_h3"
+    if not isinstance(model_index, Mapping):
+        raise ValueError("model_index.json must be an object")
+    raw = model_index.get("_minimax_h3")
+    if not isinstance(raw, Mapping):
+        raise ValueError(f"{path} must be an object")
+    path += ".sigma_shift_scales"
+    scales = raw.get("sigma_shift_scales")
+    if not isinstance(scales, Mapping):
+        raise ValueError(f"{path} must be an object")
+    result = {}
+    for modality in ("video", "audio"):
+        value = scales.get(modality)
+        error = f"{path}.{modality} must be a positive finite number"
+        if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+            raise ValueError(error)
+        try:
+            scale = float(value)
+        except OverflowError as exc:
+            raise ValueError(error) from exc
+        if not math.isfinite(scale) or scale <= 0.0:
+            raise ValueError(error)
+        result[modality] = scale
+    return result

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Invalid H3 sigma metadata must fail before fetching component weights."""
+
+import json
+import re
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from huggingface_hub.errors import EntryNotFoundError
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.minimax_h3_metadata import (
+    validate_minimax_h3_sigma_shift_scales,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines.minimax_h3_pipeline import (
+    FastH3Pipeline,
+    MiniMaxH3Pipeline,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines.minimax_h3_vdn_pipeline import (
+    VDNH3Pipeline,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines_core.composed_pipeline_base import (
+    ComposedPipelineBase,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines_core.stages.model_specific_stages.minimax_h3.release_metadata import (
+    MiniMaxH3ReleaseMetadata,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.utils.model_overlay import (
+    BUILTIN_MODEL_OVERLAY_REGISTRY,
+    MODEL_OVERLAY_METADATA_PATTERNS,
+)
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+BASE = "sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines_core.composed_pipeline_base"
+H3 = "sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines.minimax_h3_pipeline"
+
+
+def model_index(partition="fl2va"):
+    return {
+        "_class_name": "MiniMaxH3Pipeline",
+        "_diffusers_version": "0.35.0",
+        "transformer": ["sglang", "MiniMaxH3"],
+        "_minimax_h3": {
+            "schema_version": 1,
+            "partition": partition,
+            "tasks": ["t2va"] if partition == "fl2va" else ["ref2va"],
+            "sigma_shift_scales": {"video": 12, "audio": 3.5},
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def pipeline(path, subfolder=None, variant=None, cls=MiniMaxH3Pipeline):
+    obj = cls.__new__(cls)
+    obj.model_path = str(path)
+    obj.server_args = SimpleNamespace(
+        model_subfolder=subfolder,
+        model_variant=variant,
+        revision="test-revision",
+        component_weights_paths={"transformer": "merged.safetensors"},
+        transformer_weights_path=None,
+    )
+    return obj
+
+
+def write_index(root, index):
+    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    (root / "model_index.json").write_text(json.dumps(index))
+    (root / "transformer").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+
+
+class TestMiniMaxH3Metadata(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_inherited_pipelines_validate_overlay_before_weight_loading(self):
+        # Source repos have no model_index; the registered overlay supplies it.
+        for cls, repo in (
+            (
+                FastH3Pipeline,
+                "FastVideo/FastVideo-FastH3-8-Step-V2",
+            ),
+            (VDNH3Pipeline, "OpenVDN/vdn-minimax-h3"),
+        ):
+            for remote in (False, True):
+                for scale in (12.0, float("nan"), True):
+                    with (
+                        self.subTest(pipeline=cls.__name__, remote=remote, scale=scale),
+                        tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp,
+                    ):
+                        root = Path(temp)
+                        source = root / repo.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
+                        source.mkdir()
+                        overlay = root / "overlay"
+                        index = model_index()
+                        index["_minimax_h3"]["sigma_shift_scales"]["video"] = scale
+                        write_index(overlay, index)
+                        spec = BUILTIN_MODEL_OVERLAY_REGISTRY[repo]
+
+                        def metadata_download(**kwargs):
+                            self.assertEqual(kwargs["repo_id"], spec["overlay_repo_id"])
+                            self.assertEqual(
+                                kwargs["revision"], spec["overlay_revision"]
+                            )
